messages.content_text:
june 10 Notes:


Today was also an unfortunate day because I got edged on my 10:00 long setup, missed a 10:00 long setup, and missed a hotd short.
,
My draw going into the day was the unmitigated 4h fvg that also was the high of a market maker model. Market opened and rallied to the upside making it clear that our dol was that high and by 10:00 we hadn’t hit it so I was looking for continuations higher. This next part should have been an easy entry because on the 1min we opened lower after 10:00, swept a swing low, and tapped the 0.62 of the range making a 1min bullish rb. I was a little distracted and thought we may see lower so I completely missed this trade. (Screenshot 1)
,
I waited for the 5min to close next and we made a 5min bullish rb and we of course swept that same swing low and hit ote so this was also a valid entry, but my limit was missed by a few points and then we got the move up to the gap. This was the exact trade I was looking for, but unfortunately I missed it. I also missed the 1min before, another very valid 10:00 setup. Moral of the story: trust my gut, and pay attention to the htf draw. (Screenshot 2)
,
We then swept the high, completing the mmxm and tapped the 4h gap so I was looking for shorts, but we didn’t get an entry trigger until we re-swept the high and made an smt, which woul have been the entry trigger. I was thinking of market ordering after getting the smt because that was the confirmation we’re going lower as everything lined up, but I faded it and missed out on this good trade too. It wasn’t a conventional entry trigger, but in my opinion an entry trigger shows confirmation of the idea and that’s exactly what happened in this trade. (Screenshot 3)
,

DAY 12  : 2 TRADES 2 L

TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
We were in a bullish MMXM to begin the MMSM after tapping into the 4H gap. I was going to use that bias to get a long before hitting the 4H gap. Price moved very fast, missed two/three potential entries on the 15s. Was patient, saw a potential entry on the 15 sec cause 1min ob was tapped and delivered. wanted price to reach the -2 before retracing but price retraced before that. making that leg the highest leg. i didn't realize that there was an SMT at the high's either which really would have told me to not enter. Also we were already in the 4H gap's territory. I wasn't sure then, but now i understand; if price taps into a bearish 4h FVG, don't try to look for longs anymore. the probability lowered a lot after this. 
Second trade, was a rule break NGL, even though i took small size on both, it was still a rule break. but on the technicals, ES already blew through the RB, which gives NQ lower probability. Remember the decorrelation. I was thinking there would be some crazy lineup where ES hits OTE while NQ hits RB. That shit never happens. 

Psychological Analysis
Came into the session pretty fine. After missing two i felt myself trying to hunt more. i guess the fault was justifying longing within a 4h FVG. and taking a RB entry when there was a decorrelation. it would seem that the main thing is FOMO. From the first L i was like aw dang it. the second was like 'why did i take that'. i think after the first loss i was in hunting mode. moreso just for that RB. i was kinda really hoping that the RB would play out and save me here. I guess i really did want that win. cause yea i've been getting fucked for 4 weeks straight.

june 8 Notes:


I lost two trades this day trading london session and I considered one of the setups to be an A setup, the other was stupid and I think it’s best that I just accept it and I was upset after taking so many breakevens and then a loss. I still stayed in my risk parameter and technically followed all of my rules.
,
For the first trade we traded into a 1h gap, swept el and made a 5 min rb. we then traded lower and the rb landed perfectly aligned with the 0.79 so I entered off of it, but got stopped out instantly. I was definitely offside with this trade, but I was thinking we would continue to the downside like we did on Friday. We had a move up off of market open and I thought we would trade lower from here, but we just continued higher. Not a bad setup though in my opinion. (Screenshot 1)
,
The next trade I took was to continue this idea by using the ce of the 30min wick to short. This high was the asian high and I like the idea of making a relative equal high with it. there were two swing highs under the ce of the wick so I entered off of it, but got stopped out. If I had entered off of the 5min rb at the high I maybe would have taken a winning trade because my idea of relative equal highs played out. I should not have taken this trade though because I wasn’t in the right state of mind to take the trade. I was upset from losing the last just cause of how trading has gone for the last week. I should have just ended it once I got like that. Still stayed in the risk parameter though. (Screenshot 2)
,
Today was a 10:00 setup that played out absolutely beautifully. 9:30 traded lower until 10:00 and then it opened, tapped a 15min fvg and made a 5min rb that you would enter off of for a perfect 0dd entry. Textbook 10:00 entry that I wish I was watching charts to take it. (Screenshot 3)
,

Now as we are rallying I will be looking for a pullback to unmitigated 5m to take back to the upside.

Once we get obvious obvious bearish structure I start targeting downside. After the move up we get an equally strong move down. I enter in shorts at 10am which lines up with an FVG and OB above as well as an internal bearish SMT as a continuation to the downside to follow this momentum. We chop around a bit but ultimately we get delivery to SSL and my target to 50% my funded. The trade was 1.65R only because I was targeting only 1,500 but my actual tp wouldve been a 2.33R. 

In hindsight, I find this trade a bit advanced. I wasn't the most confident, it was beginning to look like a no trade day because there was simply big swings no entry, but there was a lot lining up to take this as a continuation and it worked out well.
